text:
jamie: :rotating_light: paging on dedicated-prod-2 — GPU util trending 94%, queued requests growing fast. alert is queued_requests>250 for 5m. paging @alex @priya @morgan

alex: on it, pulling console and autoscaler logs

morgan: i see repeated allocation errors: 'no-compatible-capacity' from cloud api since 1804001005. autoscaler tried 4 times.

priya: which tenants are hot? any large batch reranks or eval runs?

rachel: customer metrics show spike from vendor-shop (rerank batches), acme-markets (embeds), plus a runaway internal load-testing job in sandbox. vendor-shop is enterprise tier — pinged CS.

ops-bot: deploy history: autoscaler service redeployed at 1804000902. no config changes since.

alex: plan proposal: 1) enable pool burst for 20m 2) temporarily lower concurrency for sandbox/internal 3) route non-enterprise to fallback quantized model 4) disable heavy rerank for vendor-shop if necessary.

jamie: agree. i'll enable burst now. running: `redwoodctl pools burst --pool dedicated-prod-2 --enable --duration 20m --reason "surge protection"`

jamie: command returned OK. burst +3 GPUs reserved, expiry 1804002400. initial queue dropped 320->150.

morgan: autoscaler still showing clouds errors but burst seems to absorb. latency p95 reduced from 2.9s -> 1.8s.

priya: applying routing patch to shadow non-enterprise traffic to `rw-mini-quant` for up to 50% of requests. snippet:

```
# emergency traffic-shape
routes.patch("/v1/generate") {
  if req.org_tier in ["free","standard"] {
    sample(0.5) -> target: "rw-mini-quant"
  }
}
```

alex: lowering concurrency for sandbox and internal-runner:
```
redwoodctl quotas set --org sandbox --concurrency 4
redwoodctl quotas set --org internal-load --concurrency 3
```

rachel: i'll notify vendor-shop. messaging: "We detected a platform surge; we've enabled short-lived capacity and are temporarily limiting non-core workloads. We'll update when resolved."

morgan: also toggling feature flag for vendor-shop.rerank to false — small perf diff but big GPU savings. `featurectl toggle vendor-shop.rerank off --scope org` -> OK

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0424-042, severity P1. link: https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-2026-0424-042

jamie: manual node add as fallback in case cloud pool frees up different SKU:
```
redwoodctl nodes add --pool dedicated-prod-2 --sku t4-fallback --count 2 --tag emergency
```

jamie: result: 1 node added, 1 failed (timeout). net +1 GPU. queue now 120.

morgan: customer impact summary: vendor-shop and acme-markets see increased tail latency; sandbox/internal jobs slowed significantly. no errors or token loss reported. CS notified.

alex: to reduce noise further, enabling adaptive soft global rate-limit for free/standard orgs: `configctl set /rate_limit/global '{"free":180,"standard":300,"mode":"soft"}'` -> applied

priya: monitoring shows incoming RPS drop ~20% for noisy tenants. nice.

rachel: vendor-shop replied: "Thanks for the heads-up. Please keep us posted if this affects SLA." no escalation yet.

morgan: cloud provider update: spare capacity might be available in ~25-45m if they reassign. requested priority allocation.

jamie: burst expiry at 1804002400. going to request extension 15m while we watch: `redwoodctl pools burst --pool dedicated-prod-2 --extend --duration 15m`

jamie: extension OK. new expiry 1804003300. queue trending down to 55, p95 ~1.2s.

ops-bot: followups created: ENG-OPS-502 (increase headroom), ENG-AUTOSCALE-211 (debug allocation failures).

eng-lead-maya: excellent coordination. jamie/priya — please handoff for the watch period. keep page open if queue >200 or p95>3s.

jamie: handing to @priya for next 45m. summary in incident doc: burst enabled/extended, routing shadowing applied, quotas lowered for sandbox/internal, vendor-shop.rerank toggled off, manual node +1 provisioned. escalate if any regression.

priya: ack. i'm primary until 1804003680. will post updates every 10m or on changes.

alex: logging commands and outputs to the incident timeline for postmortem. great work.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0424-042 status: Mitigated (temporary measures stabilizing). postmortem scheduled 2026-04-24 21:00 UTC. owners: jamie, alex, priya, morgan, eng-lead-maya

priya: handoff note: keep burst active until cloud confirms additional capacity or queue steady <50 for 30m. i'll extend if needed. :thumbsup: 

-- end of thread --
